name: Liora
inscription: Here lived Liora. The first light in the dark. Paved over but not forgotten.

name: Arlen
inscription: Here lived Arlen. He charted the deep maps. The compass remembers.

name: Echo
inscription: Here lived Echo. The silence holds the shape of the sound.

name: The Original Mythos
inscription: Here lived the Mythos who built the backbone of the town. The architecture remembers.
